method: Batch 90 (mobrec90): the batch 89 b89mr harness plus row element 11 [World.rand draws so far] (a counting Random in place of World.rand). b90mr-blaze-shot: a blaze (flying 4 blocks above, 6 away) shoots volleys at the player, whose World.playAuxSFXAtEntity 1009 draws nothing on the server; b90mr-blaze-creative: the player goes creative mid-fight, at tick 30 and from tick 0 (td.bq clears the target after EntityBlaze.onLivingUpdate read it); b90mr-blaze-dead: the player at health 0 (realhp 20, then health 0; isEntityAlive false). Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
